system.description: After your first surrender in a scene, at the start of a later round spend 1 Fabula Point to rise with (Crisis value + SL × 2) HP. Surrender's consequence still lands, and the wrong-way point ticks the Miasma Clock. Fall to 0 again and you leave the scene — cleanly, no further payout.
